findings.title: Missing Model Router Call Log File

evidence.observation: Configured call log file does not exist according to model router audit

proposed_action.description: Verify log directory permissions and ensure model-router initializes call_log.jsonl on startup

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility and telemetry into model router invocation latency and status

findings.title: Direct LLM API Invocations Bypassing Model Router

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral with environment variable keys rather than routing via model router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert calls to route through the centralized model router

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures uniform fallback handling, quota management, and invocation logging across services
